packageRules.description: Tidy Go module files and rewrite import paths on major updates to satisfy CI
The base updater owns the verified runtime base image pins
Automerge digest and patch updates once every PR check passes
Digest pins keep the current release and have no release timestamp, so a release age would block them forever
cdnjs publishes no release timestamps, so a required timestamp would block these updates forever
Use published tags for shared container security actions; PR checks skip the published-image report, so review these manually
